purpose: Teach: てっきり/間抜け/漫才/王女/並木/白馬/舞う/過敏

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、てっきり、本気で、絶対、お前、絶対、部活、絶対、と、思ってたよ
lines.en: I seriously thought you were going to do club activities no matter what.
lines.style: Teasing lilt at the start. Light, playful rhythm. Quick delivery with a knowing smile underneath. The cadence of calling someone out on something obvious.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 今日、本気で、絶対、間抜けな、絶対、こと、絶対、しちゃったぜ、桜、本気で、絶対、笑い
lines.en: I actually did something really stupid today, Sakura. Laugh at me.
lines.style: Self-deprecating but with a slight edge. Dry delivery on 「stupid」. Rueful grin. Inviting her in without needing reassurance — confident in his own ridiculousness.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: お前、本気で、絶対、漫才、絶対、文化祭で、絶対、やるんだよね、リク
lines.en: So you're really doing a comedy sketch at the culture festival, right, Riku?
lines.style: Curious but gentle. Slight lean forward — genuinely interested in what he'll say next. Conversational beat before his name, like she's checking in.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 文化祭の劇で、本気で、絶対、王女、絶対、お前、絶対、やるんだぜ、桜
lines.en: And you're really going to play a princess in the culture festival play, Sakura.
lines.style: Light challenge in the delivery. Amusement underneath. The slight sing-song of someone pointing out something perfect and slightly unbelievable. Not mocking — delighted.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 学校の、本気で、絶対、並木道、絶対、桜が、絶対、咲きはじめたよね、リク
lines.en: The cherry blossoms along the path at school are starting to bloom, huh, Riku?
lines.style: Soft, almost dreamy opening. Slower pace. Voice lifts slightly on 「bloom」 — noticing something beautiful. Gentle trailing off, like she's been watching them.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 文化祭の劇、本気で、絶対、白馬、絶対、小道具、絶対、必要なんだぜ、桜
lines.en: The culture festival play is going to need a white horse prop, you know, Sakura.
lines.style: Thoughtful, matter-of-fact. Slight pause before 「prop」 — he's actually thinking through logistics. Grounded tone. Not performing — solving.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 校庭の落ち葉、本気で、絶対、ひらひら、絶対、舞うように、絶対、散ってたよね、リク
lines.en: The fallen leaves in the schoolyard were fluttering and dancing as they scattered, weren't they?
lines.style: Soft, wistful observation. Dreamy pacing on 「fluttering」. Voice follows the movement she's describing. Tender attention to small detail. Brief pause like she's still watching them.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、本気で、絶対、寒さに、絶対、過敏に、絶対、反応するよな、桜
lines.en: You really do react to the cold pretty sensitively, don't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Teasing but without edge. Light warmth underneath. The observation of someone who's noticed and remembers. Gentle affection wrapped in wry humor.
